name: marketnow
description: MarketNow — Trust layer for agent commerce. 68,388 index-certified MCP-compatible skills (132,737 total tracked). Sentinel L1 index certification on every entry, L2 deep-scan on top npm tarballs, x402 payments (HTTP 402 + USDC on Base), and AP2 delegated mandates. AliceLabs LLC Proprietary. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA).

transport.note: Supports both HTTP (SSE + JSON-RPC) and stdio transport.

tools.name: marketnow_search_skills
tools.description: Search the MarketNow registry of indexed MCP servers (68k+ across GitHub, npm and PyPI)

tools.name: marketnow_verify_trust
tools.description: Verify any AI agent credential (JWT, W3C VC, MCP Card, ATC v3, A2A, EAT-AI, ZTA, X.509)

tools.name: marketnow_translate_credential
tools.description: Translate a credential between 8 formats through the Universal Trust Schema (UTS)

tools.name: marketnow_list_formats
tools.description: List all supported credential formats with their algorithms and status

tools.name: marketnow_check_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is suspicious (scam checker). Returns risk score and reasons

tools.name: marketnow_check_revocation
tools.description: Check revocation status of an ATC (card_id) or CA key (kid) against the signed CRL

tools.name: marketnow_fingerprint_tool
tools.description: Cryptographically fingerprint MCP tool definitions (SHA-256 + RFC 8785 JCS) against tool poisoning

tools.name: marketnow_submit_skill
tools.description: Publish a skill to the MarketNow catalog (write side, Sentinel-validated)

verification.sentinel_l1: Automated static analysis on every submission (repo exists, README, package manifest, license, no hardcoded secrets, no malicious patterns)
verification.human_review: Manual review by MarketNow team before listing (24-48h)

listings.note: Listed but data is outdated (shows 9,248 skills, mentions crypto payments that don't exist). Contact mcp.so to update.

tools_note: The remote endpoint (marketnow.site/api/mcp) exposes 9 public discovery/trust tools. The npm package marketnow-mcp@1.14.1 exposes 15 LOCAL trust/security tools (verify_trust, verify_receipt, check_revocation, fingerprint_tool, mint_referral, ...) that run client-side against local credentials and the public APIs. Remote discovery surface and local package surface are different by design.
